analysis.plain_explanation: You have the right to receive your earned wages for the work you performed, and labour laws require timely payment. Since your employer in Hyderabad has not paid your salary for three months, you can file a formal claim with the labour department. The law states that wages must be paid on time, and unpaid wage claims can generally be brought within a specific time limit. You should gather your employment records and consider raising a formal complaint or seeking assistance from the local authorities. I am not a lawyer, so please consult a legal professional or the District Legal Services Authority for specific guidance on your case.

steps.title: (General) Send a formal written demand
steps.detail: Send a written demand letter or email to your employer's HR or management detailing the unpaid salary amount of Rs 90000 for the past 3 months, attaching your proof, and setting a clear deadline for payment.
steps.where: Email or registered post to the employer

steps.title: File a claim for unpaid wages
steps.detail: Raise a formal claim for unpaid wages through the state labour department or relevant labour portals such as Shram Suvidha or Samadhan, as supported by WAGES-CLAIM.
steps.where: State labour department office or online labour portals

steps.title: Approach the District Legal Services Authority
steps.detail: If you need free legal assistance or guidance to pursue your wage claim, contact the local DLSA or call the legal aid helpline, as supported by PROC-NALSA and LSA-12.
steps.where: District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) or Helpline 15100

draft_document.text:
To,
[COMPANY NAME / EMPLOYER],
[COMPANY ADDRESS, HYDERABAD]

SUBJECT: DEMAND FOR PAYMENT OF UNPAID SALARY TOTALING RS 90000

Dear Sir/Madam,

I, [YOUR NAME], was employed with your company under the offer letter dated [DATE OF OFFER LETTER]. 

I have faithfully performed my duties, but you have failed to pay my salary for the past 3 months, amounting to a total of Rs 90000. This non-payment violates applicable wage rules such as WAGES-17.

I hereby demand that you clear my full unpaid salary of Rs 90000 within 15 days of receiving this notice. Please transfer the amount directly to my bank account as per our employment terms.

If you fail to clear the dues within the given time, I will be forced to initiate formal proceedings before the labour authorities and appropriate forums.

Sincerely,
[YOUR NAME]
[YOUR CONTACT INFORMATION]
[DATE]
